uzo.purpose: Chooses one of many options from a list that opens on demand: country, language, year; options of one group name it (attribute group) and stand under its heading.

instead.kialo: Up to five options read faster when they all stay visible, because a list hides them behind a click; Fundamento covers it with elekto.

A combobox with a search in its list is the kompletigilo, because a person who knows a part of the word finds the value faster while typing; a fixed short list stays the select's (Spec 014 ⑤ closes the alternative search-in-list).
Several values from one list are the plurelektilo's, because a select takes one; it shows the chosen as a count or as tags (Spec 025 ③ closes the alternative multiple).

boundary.kialo: A drawn list with icons and descriptions is the listelektilo, because it brings its own keyboard and screen reader behaviour (Spec 025 ③ closes the boundary custom-popup); a list of words stays the platform's.
A select without a visible label shows a prompt or an option without saying what is chosen, because the prompt is gone once an option is chosen.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A select without a form has no sender, because its value is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for one of many values before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need it (a country).

containers.name: filter-bar
containers.kialo: A filter of many values folds them into one field above the list it narrows — in the region fields of the filtrilo — because a row of every value would push the list away.

with.kialo: A select stands among the fields of a form, with the same height and the width of the container, because a person reads a form top down and fills it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because choosing an option does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field.
The chevron at the end of the field is an ikono chevron-down, because the sign that a list opens below is vocabulary of the Ikonaro, drawn by the Aspekto in the size of the field.

never.kialo: A select stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the list could not be reached on its own.

case.de: Es gibt höchstens fünf Optionen, die alle sichtbar bleiben können.
case.en: There are at most five options, which can all stay visible.

case.de: Die Liste ist lang und die Person kennt einen Teil des Worts, das sie sucht.
case.en: The list is long and the person knows a part of the word they look for.

case.de: Mehrere Werte aus derselben Liste sollen gewählt werden.
case.en: Several values from the same list are to be chosen.

case.de: Die Optionen brauchen ein Symbol oder eine Beschreibung neben dem Wort.
case.en: The options need an icon or a description beside the word.

do.de: Zeig immer eine sichtbare Beschriftung, die sagt, was gewählt wird.
do.en: Always show a visible label that says what is chosen.

do.de: Fasse verwandte Optionen mit group unter einer Überschrift zusammen.
do.en: Gather related options with group under a heading.

do.de: Nimm empty-label, wenn „keine Auswahl“ selbst eine gültige Antwort ist.
do.en: Use empty-label when “no choice” is a valid answer itself.

dont.de: Einen Platzhalter und empty-label zugleich setzen, denn beide stehen für „nichts gewählt“.
dont.en: Set a placeholder and empty-label at once, because both stand for “nothing chosen”.

dont.de: Zwei Optionen mit demselben Wortlaut anbieten.
dont.en: Offer two options with the same wording.

dont.de: Den Platzhalter als Beschriftung benutzen, denn er verschwindet, sobald gewählt ist.
dont.en: Use the placeholder as the label, because it disappears once something is chosen.

action.de: Gehen zur vorigen oder nächsten Option, je nach Plattform öffnen sie zuerst die Liste; bei readonly ändert keine Taste den Wert.
action.en: Move to the previous or next option, depending on the platform they open the list first; with readonly no key changes the value.

action.de: Springen zur ersten oder letzten Option.
action.en: Jump to the first or last option.

action.de: In der offenen Liste übernimmt die Taste die markierte Option und schließt die Liste.
action.en: In the open list the key takes the marked option and closes the list.

action.de: Schließt die offene Liste, ohne die Wahl zu ändern.
action.en: Closes the open list without changing the choice.

action.de: Getippte Buchstaben springen zur Option, die mit ihnen beginnt.
action.en: Typed letters jump to the option that starts with them.
